fullTextEN: Right now my deskmate is in jail.

fullTextZH: 今天我要说说我小学的故事。
fullTextEN: Today I want to talk about my elementary school story.
When I was in elementary school,

fullTextZH: 小学的时候我有一个同桌，
fullTextEN: When I was in elementary school, I had a deskmate,

fullTextZH: 我们两个人用一张桌子。
fullTextEN: The two of us used one desk.
He is not a good kid,

fullTextZH: 不喜欢我的同桌喜欢睡觉，
fullTextEN: Doesn't like my deskmate likes sleeping,
I am afraid of my deskmate.
My deskmate said: You get up,

fullTextZH: 他在我的椅子上，呸，吐口水啊。
fullTextEN: He was on my chair, ptooey, spitting.
So I said to the teacher: Teacher,
The teacher said: You guys switch.

fullTextZH: 我的同桌是一个坏男孩，
fullTextEN: My deskmate is a bad boy,
He is not a good kid,
He is not nice to me.
My mom knows he hit me,
Mom said to the teacher: Oh,

fullTextZH: 素清需要一个新的同桌。
fullTextEN: Su Qing needs a new deskmate.

fullTextZH: 然后我有了一个新的同桌，
fullTextEN: Then I got a new deskmate,

fullTextZH: 新的同桌怎么样？也不好，
fullTextEN: How is the new deskmate? Also not good,
The new deskmate is also not good, right.

fullTextZH: 所以我不喜欢我的小学。
fullTextEN: So I don't like my elementary school.
I think my deskmate is not good.
Now my deskmate is in jail.

fullTextZH: 所以我觉得可能他没有工作，
fullTextEN: So I think maybe he doesn't have a job,
Maybe he went to steal money.
He really is a bad person,
He is not a good person,

fullTextZH: 他做了很多很多坏的事情。
fullTextEN: He did many, many bad things.
So now he is in jail.
In China, elementary school is six years,

fullTextZH: 一年级、二年级、三年级、四年级、五年级、六年级。
fullTextEN: First grade, second grade, third grade, fourth grade, fifth grade, sixth grade.

fullTextZH: 我觉得我一年级不开心，
fullTextEN: I think I was unhappy in first grade,
Fourth grade was also unhappy, ah,
In fifth grade, my deskmate was very nice,
Sixth grade was also very happy,

fullTextZH: 六年级我的同桌也很好。
fullTextEN: In sixth grade, my deskmate was also very nice.

fullTextZH: 所以我觉得我的小学听起来有一点点难。
fullTextEN: So I think my elementary school sounds a little bit difficult.
